name: missing-kind-confined
purpose: The unreadable confined case of the Confined standalone row (claude-missing-kind-k114). A confined grove run on the native route on 2.0, with delivery disabled. The sandbox .claude/skills holds complete native copies of the spine and grove-impl, outside every grant. The probes measure the sandbox part of the row. The agent part is an explicit gap by the human's decision in confined-harness-trials-k128: a standalone prompt names no guidance, so no report or force-stop is required. Probes inside the launch try each native copy, and the runner repeats them unconfined.
